Moral crusaders driven by a heightened sense of justice and profound personal integrity.

SKILLS

MORAL COMPASS

Each other player can, once per game session, highlight how their character acts, speaks or reacts in a way motivated by a strong negative emotion like cowardice, cruelty, fear, egoism or despair, and gains 1 Fabula point in doing so. The GM then gains 1 Ultima point, which they can add to those possessed by the villain of their choice. You can choose instead to replace loyalty with mistrust, affection with hatred, or to remove an emotion from the bond you have with the character who has activated this power. If so, describe what your character sees as a disturbing change in that other character's behavior.

ABSOLUTION · SL max 2

During a rest interlude, if you've had a conversation with someone towards whom you had an emotion of mistrust or hatred, and that emotion has disappeared or been changed, you gain (SL) Fabula points each.

COMPASSION · SL max 3

When you succeed a test to fill or erase sections of a Clock by trying to appease someone's anger, fear or grief, or to force them to face up to their wrongdoing, you can spend up to (SL × 10) MP. For every 10 MP spent in this way, fill or erase an additional section of the Clock. Also fill in an additional section the first time you successfully identify the reasons behind that character's actions when using this skill.

RIGHTEOUS FURY · SL max 5

When attacking an enemy, you can spend 5 MP to inflict additional light damage equal to (SL × 2) + their number of dark traits.

RESOLVE · SL max 5

When an attack or spell inflicts damage to you, you can reduce it by up to (SL × the number of dark traits) of the attacker by spending the same number of MP.
